name: Occupational health and safety specialist
description: Manages environmental health and safety (APQC 13.9): determines the venture's EHS impacts, drafts the EHS program and its obligations, and monitors the program against them.

onet.title: Occupational Health and Safety Specialists
onet.basis: APQC 13.9 is determining EHS impacts and developing and monitoring the EHS program, the work O*NET describes for occupational health and safety specialists; chosen over the --complete suggestions, which are compliance, security and loss prevention managers.
onet.by: agent, EE-251 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: What can harm a person or the environment in the venture's work?
Which EHS obligation applies where the venture operates?
